title: Total Body Fusion
description: 3-round circuit with isometric squat, decline push-ups, bear hold and walking lunges for a full body burn

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Isometric squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the bottom squat position with no support

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Bear hold
exercises.instructions: On all fours, knees lifted 2cm off the floor, hold

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.instructions: Advance with continuous lunges, big steps

exercises.name: Star jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs in a star shape

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
